limitations: These previously viewed outcomes are development diagnostics, not a fresh holdout.
Anchoring changes the forecast contract from global level to conditional increment.
Trend-only ablation reuses the joint trend; it is not a separately fitted baseline.
Ablations do not measure the new frequency-refinement or bootstrap implementations.
Historical adjusted snapshots have no point-in-time availability guarantee.
No significance, calibrated coverage, profitability or generalization claim is made.

methodology.aggregation: pooled errors across every scored offset; direction at horizon endpoint
methodology.baseline: last observed log adjusted close at each matching cutoff
methodology.original: saved global harmonic level; reconstructed from saved basis and coefficients
methodology.retuning: none; uses archived coefficients, periods, fold boundaries and targets
methodology.without_drift: anchored harmonic forecast minus saved fitted trend increment
